description: EXAMPLE local providers file for ProviderManager - copy to providers.json under the platform config dir (e.g. ~/.config/AgentSoftware/providers.json) or point LLM_PROVIDERS_CONFIG at it. Entries use the same schema as the bundled providers.default.json resource; by provider id they override the default fields field-by-field, and new ids are appended. The api_keys map keeps secrets out of the committed default catalog.

providers.name: My local Ollama
providers.description: Example of a brand-new provider added only by the local file
